swiper

Swiper view container. Only the swiper-item component can be placed. Otherwise, undefined behavior may occur.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
indicator-dots Boolean false No Whether to display the panel indicator.
indicator-color String rgba(0, 0, 0, .3) No Indicator color.
indicator-active-color String #000000 No Color of the selected indicator.
autoplay Boolean false No Whether to enable automatic switchover.
current Number 0 No Index of the current swiper.
interval Number 5000 No Automatic switchover interval.
duration Number 500 No Sliding animation duration.
circular Boolean false No Whether to use joint sliding.
vertical Boolean false No Whether the sliding direction is vertical.
easing-function String "default" No Easing animation type for swiper switchover.
bindchange eventHandle No The change event triggered when the current value changes. The output is event.detail = {current}.

Valid Values of easing-function

Value Description
default Default easing function.
linear Linear animation.
easeInCubic Ease-in animation.
easeOutCubic Ease-out animation.
easeInOutCubic Ease-in and ease-out animation.

Sample Code


Page({
    data: {
        background: [
            {color: 'pink', text: 'Macle'},
            {color: 'peru', text: 'miniProgram'},
            {color: 'yellowgreen', text: 'Swiper'}
        ],
        indicatorDots: true,
        autoplay: true,
        vertical: false,
        interval: 2000,
        circular: false,
        duration: 1000,
    },
    onLoad() {
    },
    whetherDisplayPanelIndicator(e) {
        this.setData({
            indicatorDots: !this.data.indicatorDots,
        });
    },
    adoptDirectionVertical() {
        this.setData({
            vertical: !this.data.vertical,
        });
    },
    adoptCircular(e) {
        this.setData({
            circular: !this.data.circular,
        });
    },
    adoptAutoplayInterval(e) {
        this.setData({
            autoplay: !this.data.autoplay,
        });
    },
    intervalAdopt(e) {
        this.setData({
            interval: e.detail.value,
        });
    },
    durationAdopt(e) {
        console.log(e.detail.value);
        this.setData({
            duration: e.detail.value,
        });
    }
});


<view class="container">
    <view class="page-description">Slider View Container</view>
    <view class="page-section">
        <view class="page-section-demo">
            <swiper style="height:150px" class="demo-swiper" previousMargin="10px" nextMargin="10px"
                    indicator-dots="{{indicatorDots}}" autoplay="{{autoplay}}" vertical="{{vertical}}"
                    interval="{{interval}}" circular="{{circular}}" duration="{{duration}}">
                <swiper-item ma:key="swiper-item-{{index}}" ma:for="{{background}}">
                    <view class="swiper-item ma_{{item.color}}">{{item.text}}</view>
                </swiper-item>
            </swiper>
        </view>
        <view class="pagination-section-control">
            <view>
                Display Panel Display Point
                <view>
                    <switch bindchange="whetherDisplayPanelIndicator" checked="{{indicatorDots}}"/>
                </view>
            </view>
            <view>
                Whether the sliding direction is vertical
                <view>
                    <switch bindchange="adoptDirectionVertical" checked="{{vertical}}"/>
                </view>
            </view>
            <view>
                Whether joint sliding is adopted
                <view>
                    <switch bindchange="adoptCircular" checked="{{circular}}"/>
                </view>
            </view>
            <view>
                Automatic switchover
                <view>
                    <switch bindchange="adoptAutoplayInterval" checked="{{autoplay}}"/>
                </view>
            </view>
            <view>
                <slider bindchange="intervalAdopt" value="{{interval}}" show-value min="500" max="30000"/>
                <view>Automatic switchover interval(ms)</view>
            </view>
            <view>
                <slider bindchange="durationAdopt" value="{{duration}}" show-value min="500" max="30000"/>
                <view>Sliding animation duration(ms)</view>
            </view>
        </view>
    </view>
</view>



.swiper-item {
    display: block;
    height: 150px;
    margin: 10px;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 150px;
    font-size: 20px;
}

.pagination-section-control {
    padding: 12px;
}

.pagination-section-control view {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}


.margin-t {
    margin-top: 24px;
}

.ma_pink {
    background-color: pink;
}

.ma_peru {
    background-color: peru;
}

.ma_yellowgreen {
    background-color: yellowgreen;
}

Bug & Tip

  1. If setData is used to change the value of current in the event callback function of bindchange, setData may be repeatedly invoked.
